properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. flo2's F29, 2026-09-20, relayed and triaged 2026-09-21. Their framing: twelve registered artifacts that are "not deleted, not lost, and not stale — they are in a different repository, which flo2 already declares properly via `external_dependency`", producing 12 of 22 findings that cannot be dispositioned at all, identical on every pass.

📌 READ `fact:the-out-of-tree-notion-exists-but-is-keyed-on-the-path-shape-and-only-one-instrument-honours-it` FIRST — the measurement changes the starting point. An absolute location outside the root ALREADY answers `unmeasurable / outside_root` and is not a finding; flo2's twelve carry RELATIVE locations, so they resolve under the root and read as missing. The concept exists; it is inferred from the path rather than declared, and `reflow2_check.py` does not honour it even when it fires.

OPTIONS, NONE CHOSEN. The first three are flo2's own, in the order they ranked them; the fourth is what the measurement suggests and they could not have seen.

(a) AN `external: true` FLAG (or `provenance: external`) THAT RECONCILE HONOURS — excluded from local measurement and reported under its own heading, "12 external, not measured", rather than as twelve absences. Their first choice, and cheapest in their reading. It makes the existing `provenance: imported` mean something operationally. ⚠️ Counter: it adds vocabulary to say something the location could already say, and a flag the author must remember is a flag the author will forget — the same shape as every other opt-in field this design has measured going empty.

(b) RESOLVE SUCH ARTIFACTS AGAINST THE DECLARED `external_dependency` INSTEAD OF THE REPO ROOT. Strictly better in their words, "because it makes upstream drift DETECTABLE — `upstream_status` already knows where reflow2's design export is". ⚠️ Counter: larger, and it makes one design's reconcile depend on another checkout being present, which turns a clean pass into a machine-dependent one.

(c) FAILING BOTH, SAY SO IN THE REPORT — group the findings whose artifacts carry `provenance: imported` and label them, so a reader sees a category rather than twelve problems. Palliative and honest; it fixes the readership cost, which is the cost they actually measured, without touching the model.

(d) MAKE THE EXISTING NOTION DECLARABLE RATHER THAN INFERRED, and teach the gate to read it. The measurement says reflow2 already has exactly one branch for this and reaches it only by accident of path shape. The smallest honest repair may be to let the author say what the path currently has to imply, and to make `reflow2_check.py` treat `outside_root` the way `reconcile_artifacts` does — because today the same artifact in the same state is a note to one instrument and a build failure to the other. ⚠️ Counter: this is (a) wearing different clothes if it lands as a new property; it is only cheaper if the declaration reuses something already there.

🛑 WHAT IS NOT IN DOUBT, WHICHEVER IS CHOSEN: the two instruments must agree. An artifact that `reconcile_artifacts` calls unmeasurable and the CI gate calls missing is a contradiction the design states about itself, and it cost this project a red build on an unrelated PR within an hour of the class being met.

⚠️ AND THE ONE THING flo2 DELIBERATELY DID NOT DO IS WORTH PRESERVING AS A CONSTRAINT: they did not delete the twelve nodes to clear the report, because "they hold real information — the upstream schema surface flo2 builds against". Any option that ends with somebody deleting them to get a green pass is the wrong one, for the reason `dec:a-dated-field-report-is-registered-and-parked` already gives: deleting is the option that LOOKS clean.
properties.name: OPEN — how does an artifact say it belongs to ANOTHER repository? The notion already exists and is inferred from the path shape, so the question is whether to declare it, resolve it, or just group it in the report
properties.rationale: Recorded open because the measurement moved the question from "invent a concept" to "declare, resolve, or merely report a concept that already exists", and those have very different costs — but it did not choose between them, and the choice is Anthony's. Option (c) is separable and fixes the measured cost (readership) without touching the model, which is a hint that it may be worth taking regardless of which structural option wins.
